```{python}
import yaml
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown

def render_glossary(file_path):
    with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        glossary_data = yaml.safe_load(f)
        
    df = pd.DataFrame(list(glossary_data.items()), columns=["Begriff", "Erklärung"])
    df = df.sort_values(by="Begriff", key=lambda x: x.str.lower())
    
    return Markdown(df.to_markdown(index=False))

render_glossary("glossary.yml")
```
